notes.title: Chessmates v1.1 is released!
notes.content:
Hello, it's a small update to Chessmates. For now no any playable content were added, only few interface improvements and new music.
Full list of features:
0. New GUI appearance.
1. Replaced (probably temporarily) pixel font by a vector font.
2. Added Credits button to Main Menu.
3. New background.
4. Added clickable button on right-top corner of the window.
5. Added turkish translation.
